messages:
Sam (CS): Orchid reported onboarding failures — spike of 401s then 429s when they ramp containers. They use our JS SDK in a serverless pool.
Orchid Ops: Logs show many `GET /v1/embed` returning 401, then a flood of `POST /auth/refresh 429 rate_limit`. Happens ~15s after deploy when instances warm up.
Irene (Eng): Sounds like token refresh stampede + immediate retries. Are they doing refresh on every cold start?
Orchid Ops: Yes, their init hook calls `sdk.client.ensureToken()` across parallel lambdas. No backoff or caching.
Max (SDK): Two quick mitigations: (1) client-side leader election (fast path) using host-local lock or redis; (2) defensive SDK config: `refresh_window_sec` and `refresh_backoff_ms`.
Jules (Onboard): They prefer not to change infra (no redis), want a config-only workaround. Any non-invasive options?
Max (SDK): We can publish an interim patch that enables local-process leader election using randomized TTL filelock when /tmp is available, plus a jittered backoff. Example envs: `REDWOOD_SDK_LEADER_LOCK=/tmp/rw_lock`, `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_BACKOFF_MS=500`, `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_JITTER=0.2`.
Orchid Ops: /tmp works for them (ephemeral lambdas on same warm VM). Could try.
Irene (Eng): Also recommend server-side soft-accept for overlapping refresh within 6s to account for jitter. SRE, can we add a small grace window?
DeployBot: Config change requested: auth-service refresh_grace_seconds=6 by jules.auth-tweak. Running canary.
DeployBot: Canary passed, rolling to staging.
Orchid Ops: Applied env vars and redeployed. Observed initial 401s reduced; refresh calls collapsed to 1-2 per host. No 429s so far.
Sam (CS): Nice. Any follow-ups for production?
Max (SDK): I'll cut a 0.9.2 SDK patch with filelock leader election + unit tests. I'll add docs recommending `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_BACKOFF_MS` for serverless pools.
Irene (Eng): We'll merge server-side grace permanently but keep it small. Also adding metric gauge `refresh_concurrency` so we can alert if >3 concurrent refreshes per tenant in 10s.
Jules (Onboard): I'll send Orchid a short runbook: env flags, restart steps, and how to verify via logs: `grep refresh /var/log/orchid | grep 429`.
Orchid Ops: Thanks — onboarding resumed, will watch prod ramp.
Sam (CS): Marking as mitigated. I'll note in account health that renewal risk lowered but flag early ramp for a week.
Max (SDK): PR link & changelog when ready (will include migration note).
Irene (Eng): Adding a brief postmortem note under runbook section "token refresh stampede" with sample configs for serverless and containerized deployments.
Jules (Onboard): Offer a 30-min follow-up call with Orchid if they want help validating rollout.
Sam (CS): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
